text:
version = 3

[bridge]
enabled = true

[agents.bb-provider]
enabled = true
role = "provider"
label = "BB-Provider"

[agents.bb-provider.identity]
hostId = "bb-local"
machineId = "bb-machine"
accountId = "bb-account"
agentKind = "custom"
label = "BB-Provider"

[agents.bb-provider.runtime]
scopeId = "bb-scope"
dataDirectory = "data/bb-provider"
policy = { revision = 1, allowedConsumers = ["bb-receiver-1","bb-receiver-2"], allowedManagers = [] }
cli = { camoExecutable = "/opt/homebrew/bin/camo", searchExecutable = "/opt/homebrew/bin/rg", searchRoot = "files", profilePrefix = "teams-bb-provider" }

[agents.bb-provider.services.file-search]
version = "1"
operations = ["search"]
resources = [{ resourceId = "search-slot", capacity = 2, unit = "slot" }]

[agents.bb-provider.services.browser]
version = "1"
operations = ["context.create","navigate","snapshot","context.destroy"]
resources = [
  { resourceId = "browser-context", capacity = 2, unit = "context" },
  { resourceId = "browser-slot", capacity = 2, unit = "slot" },
]

[agents.bb-receiver-1]
enabled = true
role = "receiver"
label = "bb-receiver-1"

[agents.bb-receiver-1.identity]
hostId = "bb-local"
machineId = "bb-machine"
accountId = "bb-account"
agentKind = "custom"
label = "bb-receiver-1"

[agents.bb-receiver-1.runtime]
scopeId = "bb-scope"
dataDirectory = "data/bb-receiver-1"
policy = { revision = 1, allowedConsumers = [], allowedManagers = [] }
cli = { camoExecutable = "/missing/camo", searchExecutable = "/opt/homebrew/bin/rg", searchRoot = "files", profilePrefix = "teams-bb-receiver-1" }

[agents.bb-receiver-1.connect]
targetAgentId = "bb-provider"
capabilityId = "browser"
capabilityVersion = "1"
operation = "context.create"
demands = [{ resourceId = "browser-context", amount = 1 }, { resourceId = "browser-slot", amount = 1 }]

[agents.bb-receiver-2]
enabled = true
role = "receiver"
label = "bb-receiver-2"

[agents.bb-receiver-2.identity]
hostId = "bb-local"
machineId = "bb-machine"
accountId = "bb-account"
agentKind = "custom"
label = "bb-receiver-2"

[agents.bb-receiver-2.runtime]
scopeId = "bb-scope"
dataDirectory = "data/bb-receiver-2"
policy = { revision = 1, allowedConsumers = [], allowedManagers = [] }
cli = { camoExecutable = "/missing/camo", searchExecutable = "/opt/homebrew/bin/rg", searchRoot = "files", profilePrefix = "teams-bb-receiver-2" }

[agents.bb-receiver-2.connect]
targetAgentId = "bb-provider"
capabilityId = "browser"
capabilityVersion = "1"
operation = "context.create"
demands = [{ resourceId = "browser-context", amount = 1 }, { resourceId = "browser-slot", amount = 1 }]
